message: Create a new Universal Machine called Notes Improver.
text:
I declared **Notes Improver** (`notes_improver`) as a Universal Machine. It is unconfirmed, so it doesn't run and costs nothing until you confirm it.

You gave no purpose, so I copied the daily notes loop from earlier. That means it runs once a day, tries to raise notes files added per day, and is judged on the Notes Files stock rising over 7 days. It runs at 09:00 UTC (my guess) and costs about $0.03 a day.

This duplicates **Notes Files Improver**, the draft I made a moment ago. Do you want me to discard that one, or should Notes Improver do something different? Say "confirm Notes Improver" to start it, or tell me what else it should do.

state.title: Notes Improver

invariants: It reads the Notes Files stock and its daily growth before acting and states the number it started from.
It never removes a measurement, a test or a check to make the count look better.
It never approves, merges or pushes anything, nor cancels the owner's work.
Work that changes the repository goes to the Coordinator as requirements, not made directly.
steps: Read the Notes Files stock and its change over the last day and the last week.
Read the recent ticket events (task.requested, gate.landed, changes.requested) to see what limited notes files landing.
Pick one change that should raise notes files added per day, and state a prediction for it (which way, by when).
Hand the change to the Coordinator as requirements, or tell the owner when it needs their choice.
Write one line on what it did and the day's count.

guessed: its purpose: taken to be the daily notes-files loop the owner described earlier, as they gave none here
